items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: there was one of the trustees, Mr. Balsall... he said, Mr. Balsall, I made one of them myself, my honor.

ctx.x: This was before the Florida job? Before.

Before. I went there and taught the school bands. That's what I wanted to do. And I suppose if I hadn't gotten in the Army, I probably would have made my home in Florida because there was one of the trustees, Mr. Balsall, Cullicolor, that owned a lot of property. I made one of them. Owned a couple of orange groves. And he said, Mr. Balsall, I made one of them myself, my honor. Land was very cheap. Land was very cheap. And he said, next year, you'll get yourself a part of land. I showed you how to go on. He had a…
I liked that. I liked that. I liked that. I liked that. I liked that. I liked that.
